name: U.S. in circle collar / lapel insignia, metal (NCOs)
size_basis: No dimension in CAPR 39-1; same overall 1.05 in as the plain US insignia, ring 0.075 in, letters 0.58 in wide

mounts.uniform: Class A / service coat, NCOs and adults without grade who will become NCOs
mounts.rule: on each lapel halfway up the seam, resting on but not over it; circles are worn around the US insignia for NCOs only (4.1.5.2.2.1.1, 4.1.9.4.1.1)

documented: circled US lapel insignia, NCOs (Fig A6-5)
